name: Reactor Siphon
body:
You can generate small amounts of power from your internal power source to recharge aethertech devices.

Prerequisite(s): Knowledge (arcana or engineering) 3, phalanx

Benefit(s): Once per day as a standard action you may recharge a piece of aethertech by a number of charges of aetheric energy equal to your Constitution bonus (minimum 1). These charges are temporary and any charges unused at the end of the round are lost.

Special: If you have the Efficient Recharger feat, you may use Reactor Siphon as a move action.
